objective: Al terminar respondes preguntas difíciles de una entrevista de trabajo con estructura, ejemplos concretos y frases naturales.

warmup.prompt_es: 'Háblame de ti', '¿cuál es tu mayor defecto?', 'cuéntame una vez que resolviste un problema'. Hay respuestas que funcionan y otras que cierran puertas.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Tell me a little about yourself.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I'm a graphic designer. I've been working freelance for four years, and I've worked with clients in six countries.
lines.es: Soy diseñadora gráfica. Llevo cuatro años trabajando por mi cuenta y he trabajado con clientes de seis países.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: What would you say is your greatest strength?
lines.es: ¿Cuál diría que es su mayor virtud?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I'm very organised. For example, last year I managed three big projects at the same time and delivered them all on time.
lines.es: Soy muy organizada. Por ejemplo, el año pasado gestioné tres proyectos grandes a la vez y los entregué todos a tiempo.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I tend to be a perfectionist. I used to spend too long on details, but now I set time limits for each task.
lines.es: Tiendo a ser perfeccionista. Antes dedicaba demasiado tiempo a los detalles, pero ahora me pongo límites de tiempo en cada tarea.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Because I have the right experience, I learn quickly, and as soon as I join, I'll be ready to work with your team.
lines.es: Porque tengo la experiencia adecuada, aprendo rápido y en cuanto me incorpore estaré lista para trabajar con su equipo.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Where do you see yourself in five years?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: I hope I'll be leading a team and developing creative campaigns here.
lines.es: Espero estar dirigiendo un equipo y desarrollando campañas creativas aquí.

glossary.example: We delivered the project on time.
Where will you be in five years?
For example, I led a team.

md_es: | *Tell me about yourself.* | presente + experiencia (present perfect) | *I'm a … I've been working … for …* |
| *What's your greatest strength?* | cualidad + ejemplo real | *I'm very organised. For example, … * |
| *What's your weakness?* | defecto real + cómo lo mejoras | *I tend to … but now I …* |
| *Why should we hire you?* | encaje + beneficios | *I have the right experience and I learn quickly.* |
| *Where do you see yourself in five years?* | futuro realista | *I hope I'll be … / I'd like to be …* |
| *Describe a time when…* | historia con tiempos narrativos | *Last year I … , so I … , and in the end …* |
1. **S**ituation: *Last year, our team had a tight deadline.*
2. **T**ask: *I was responsible for the final report.*
3. **A**ction: *I organised a daily meeting and shared the work.*
4. **R**esult: *We finished two days early and the client was delighted.*
**Frases útiles:** *I'm keen on … · I'm a quick learner · I work well in a team · I can handle pressure · I'm willing to …*
- *My weakness is that I work too much* (suena a respuesta ensayada): mejor un defecto real y su solución.

exercises.situation_es: Estás en una entrevista de trabajo y te preguntan por una experiencia.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: Can you describe a time when you solved a problem at work?

turns.speaker: You
choices: Last year, a client was unhappy with the delay, so I organised a meeting, and in the end we solved it.
Last year a client was unhappy by the delay, so I organise a meeting and at the end we solve it.
I solved a problem very good last year.
turns.why_es: STAR: situación, acción y resultado con tiempos narrativos.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: And what did you learn from that experience?

turns.speaker: You
choices: I learnt that communication is essential, and I've applied that lesson ever since.
I learned that communication is essentials, and I applied it since.
turns.why_es: Pasado simple + present perfect con ever since.

exercises.prompt: Escribe tus respuestas (6 a 8 frases en total) a: 'Tell me about yourself' y 'What's your greatest strength?'. Usa presente, present perfect y un ejemplo concreto.
exercises.model_answer: I'm a sales assistant and I've been working in retail for three years. I'm very organised and I work well in a team. For example, last winter I managed the stock of the whole shop while my manager was ill, and we didn't have any problems. I'm also a quick learner: I learned the new system in only two days. In the future, I'd like to lead a small team.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
